project.name: M-VAVE FM-1 Study and Setup Plan
project.objective: Create a reproducible knowledge base and operating setup for the M-VAVE FM-1 FM synthesizer and MIDI controller.

device.category: six-operator FM synthesizer and MIDI controller

goals: Understand the six-operator FM architecture, algorithms, envelopes, LFO, effects, arpeggiator, and sequencer.
Build reliable audio and wired USB MIDI workflows before BLE MIDI.
Document presets, global MIDI channels, SysEx imports, sequences, and firmware state.
Prefer Linux-native routing and retain evidence for editor or firmware-dependent work.
